items.title: 56711_Buster Smith oral history interview
items.q: Reuben Roddy was the main tenor... we didn't have no tenor player at all... went back to Minneapolis

ctx.x: Reuben Roddy. He was from Pueblo(?). So we wanted Lester, and sent the boys up to talk with him, and when they went to talk with him, he says, "Oh, I can't leave." So we went away and stayed about a week away. Went back on the highway (and we all bought two or three new cars in the band), and went back to Minneapolis.
